wall.purpose: velvet-dark enclosing field without total closure

fire.purpose: one low contained fire; warmth without sovereignty

cushion.purpose: one low velvet cushion; rest without throne grammar

threshold.purpose: permeable way out / way back; visually available

negative_space.purpose: protected breathing room between warmth, rest, and threshold

relations: fire and cushion are not mirrored across a central axis
negative_space separates the main masses rather than becoming a focal object
threshold remains open and visually distinct from the fire
fire is lower than the cushion's visual center
no region is permitted to become a throne or altar axis
